sections.title: The letter sound
paragraphs: The letter name is (ы) /ɨ/, that is a close central vowel. This letter makes the vowel sound in (сын) /sɨn/, which means son. It has two sounds in spoken Russian.

sections.title: Making the sound
paragraphs: Pull your tongue back into the middle of your mouth. Keep your lips flat and spread slightly. Vibrate your vocal cords with a tense throat. For the unstressed sound, relax your tongue slightly downwards. Touch your throat to feel the strong steady vibration.

sections.title: Reading the variants
paragraphs: In stressed syllables after hard consonants, say the sound /ɨ/, that is a close central vowel, as in (дым) /dɨm/. In unstressed syllables, make the shorter sound /ɨ̞/, that is a lower central vowel, as in (рыбак) /rɨ̞ˈbak/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not say the sound in the English word sit. Do not make the sound in the English word see. Pull your tongue farther back in your mouth instead.
